lead_raw_text:
The structure of Sr2Mg12Ni2 (SrMg6Ni) crystallizes in the hexagonal space group P6_3/mmc (No. 194), with 16 atoms in the unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived CrystalNN analysis identifies close-packed-like local arrangements for all centers: Mg and Ni each have 12 geometric neighbors, while Sr has 12 neighbors, with neighbor distances ranging from about 3.11 to 3.33 Å. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 16 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations show Mg-centered 12-vertex coordination polyhedra sharing corners, edges, and faces, while Mg–Mg and Mg–Sr polyhedra exhibit corner- and edge-sharing.
